    def multimegasweep(
        self,
        slow_params: list[Parameter],
        slow_v_list: list[Setpoints],
        fast_params: list[Parameter],
        fast_v_list: list[Setpoints],
        slow_delay: float = 0.0,
        fast_delay: float = 0.0,
        init_delay: bool = True,
    ) -> SweepResult:
        self._check_interrupted()
        if not all(len(sp) == len(fast_v_list[0]) for sp in fast_v_list):
            raise ValueError("not all fast axis setpoint lists have same length!")
        if not all(len(sp) == len(slow_v_list[0]) for sp in slow_v_list):
            raise ValueError("not all slow axis setpoint lists have same length!")

        slow_vs = [list(i) for i in zip(*slow_v_list)]
        fast_vs = [list(i) for i in zip(*fast_v_list)]

        with (
            self._sweep_context(),
            sweep.db.Writer(self._basedir) as w,
            self._plotter as p,
        ):
            self.logger.info(f"Starting multimegasweep with ID {w.id}")
            slowparamlist: list[str] = []
            for param in slow_params:
                slowparamlist.append(param.full_name)

            fastparamlist: list[str] = []
            for param in fast_params:
                fastparamlist.append(param.full_name)

            self.logger.debug(f"Slows: {slowparamlist}, Fasts: {fastparamlist}")
            min_duration = (
                len(slow_vs) * len(fast_vs) * fast_delay + len(slow_vs) * slow_delay
            )
            self.logger.info(f"Minimum duration {_sec_to_str(min_duration)}")

            self._init_metadata(
                w,
                type="2D",
                function="multimegasweep",
                slow_delay=slow_delay,
                fast_delay=fast_delay,
                slow_params=slowparamlist,
                fast_params=fastparamlist,
                columns=["time"] + slowparamlist + fastparamlist + self._col_names(),
                slow_setpoints=[list(sps) for sps in slow_v_list],
                fast_setpoints=[list(sps) for sps in fast_v_list],
            )
            p.set_cols(w.metadata["columns"])

            for i, slow_v in enumerate(_progress(slow_vs, position=0)):
                self.logger.debug(f"{i + 1}/{len(slow_vs)}: {slowparamlist} = {slow_v}")
                for slow_param, ov in zip(slow_params, slow_v):
                    slow_param(ov)

                for j, fast_v in enumerate(_progress(fast_vs, position=1, leave=False)):
                    for fast_param, iv in zip(fast_params, fast_v):
                        fast_param(iv)

                    if not init_delay and i == 0 and j == 0:
                        pass
                    elif j == 0:
                        interruptible_sleep(
                            slow_delay,
                            show_progress=False,
                            should_stop=self._should_stop,
                        )

                    if self._should_stop():
                        self.logger.warning(f"ID {w.id} INTERRUPTED")
                        self._interrupted = True
                        w.metadata["interrupted"] = True
                        break

                    time.sleep(fast_delay)

                    self._run_run_befores(
                        station=self,
                        writer=w,
                    )

                    data = [time.time()] + slow_v + fast_v + self._measure()
                    w.add_point(data)
                    p.add_point(data)

                    self._run_run_afters(
                        station=self,
                        data=data,
                        writer=w,
                    )

                    if self._should_stop():
                        self.logger.warning(f"ID {w.id} INTERRUPTED")
                        self._interrupted = True
                        w.metadata["interrupted"] = True
                        break

                if self._should_stop():
                    self.logger.warning(f"ID {w.id} INTERRUPTED")
                    self._interrupted = True
                    w.metadata["interrupted"] = True
                    break

            w.metadata["end_time"] = time.time()
            image = p.send_image()
            if image is not None:
                w.add_blob("plot.png", image)
                display.display(display.Image(data=image, format="png"))

# === Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`; governs: tetralayer-stacking-fs-count Step 4) ===
# fast: paired (Vtg, Vbg) n-line n = 3.25 -> 2.00e12 (30 pts) at D = 0 (run-5 cal)
# slow: magnet.field 0.9 -> 10 T uniform in 1/B (103 rows, d(1/B) = 0.0099 1/T = 1/(3 F_L(n_max)))
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
from hera.analysis import field_invB
# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; same constants as spot checks runs 6-7) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
N_HI, N_LO, N_N = 3.25, 2.00, 30                 # 1e12 cm^-2; dn = 0.043 = ray spacing 4eB/h at B_lo / 2
B_LO, B_HI, N_B = 0.90, 10.0, 103                # B_lo = sdh_onset of run 6 (0.91 T); B_hi = session cap
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 2.1, 3.0                # 7 tau at tau = 0.3 s / 24 dB (settling floor); flyback settle
SENS = 50e-6                                     # sr1: 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA (spot checks peaked at 12 % FS)
I_TRIP, T_TRIP = 1e-9, 2.0                       # A, K — auto-abort thresholds (E1: no eyes on the live plot)
ns = np.linspace(N_HI, N_LO, N_N); Ds = np.zeros_like(ns)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtgs, Vbgs = np.asarray(Vtgs, float), np.asarray(Vbgs, float)
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, \

cat > hera_scratch/md_fan_e.md <<'EOF'
## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`, governed by `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count`)

**Why this fan.** The spot checks (runs 6–7, ana) show clean SdH on both sides with sub-1 T onsets. They cannot decide the stacking at one density. At n = +3.2×10¹², tones sit at 7.1, 22.3 and 29.5 T, and nothing at F_L = 33.1 T. The 22.3 and 29.5 T tones read either as harmonics of 7.1 T or as an ABAB heavy pocket, and each pairing closes the Luttinger sum at a different lever-arm scale (0.89 or 1.11). Only the **n-dependence** separates them: a harmonic tracks k·f exactly, a pocket follows its own Onsager curve, and f₁ + f₂ = F_L(n) across density pins the scale. **Side: electron.** At D = 0 the hole side ends at −1.27×10¹² (TG limit), inside the near-CNP exception regime. The electron side reaches +3.25×10¹², where the ABAB heavy tone sits 3.5–7.5 T below F_L.

**Design (binding checks computed, one fan):**
- **B_lo = 0.90 T**: the run-6 `sdh_onset` gives 0.91 T.
- **n_max = 3.25×10¹²**: the D = 0 line meets the TG limit here (V_tg = 0.998 V).
- **n_min = 2.0×10¹²**: the model heavy-tone vs F_L split (3.55 T) is ≥ 2·δF_heavy (1.5 T). The partner tone reaches ≥ 5 periods from 2.5×10¹².
- **N_n = 30**: the ray-Nyquist floor, 2 points per 4eB/h = 0.087×10¹² at B_lo.
- **N_B = 103, uniform in 1/B**: Δ(1/B) = 1/(3·F_L(n_max)) = 0.0099 T⁻¹, which puts the Nyquist frequency at 50 T. The 1/(2F_L) floor (69 rows) would put a scale-1.1 singleton (37 T) past Nyquist, folding onto the heavy-tone band. 103 rows also keep the folded heavy 2nd harmonic out of the 0–40 T claim band.
- **Resolution**: δF = 1.0 T over the 0.91–10 T record.
- **Dwell**: fast_delay **2.1 s = 7τ** (τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB/oct, the settling floor). The n-axis carries oscillations, so under-settling would cost the heavy tone.
- **Dynamic range**: sr1 fixed at **50 µV = 5 kΩ FS**. The spot checks peaked at 530/590 Ω at 10 T (11–12 %) on either side of this density window. The worst corner, n = 2.0 × 10 T, is expected below 1 kΩ, so headroom is ≥ 5×.

**Price:** 200 min computed:
- grid: 3090 pts × 2.22 s = 114 min (read overhead 0.10 s/pt from run 5)
- traverse: 9.1 T bare at 0.137 T/min = 66 min
- row overhead: settle 3 s (run 6) + slow_delay 3 s + flyback 1 s = 13 min
- magnet positioning 0 → 0.9 T: 7 min

The ETA adds ~10 %, the session's overrun on inherited estimates. **Coverage trade:**
- The hole side is excluded (preview in run 7 stands).
- n < 2.0 is excluded: those columns have heavy/F_L splits under 2δF and partners under 3.5 periods. Going down to 1.5×10¹² would cost +12 columns ≈ +45 min for no resolvable tones.
- Column 2 sits at n = 3.207, next to run 6. It gives a uniform-1/B vs uniform-B grid-change reproduction at no extra cost.

**Guards (E1):**
- Gate current > 1 nA or T_sample > 2 K → interrupt, with gates parked.
- sr1 clips are logged, not aborted: one clip corrupts only its own column.
- An interrupt does not stop a magnet ramp; the worst case is the supply finishing its ≤ 0.9 T step.

**Ends at 10 T with gates at 0.** The next step (LK mass split or a ride-down) starts from 10 T, so no re-traverse. **Checkpoints:**
- **First rows** at 0.9 T (≈ 10 min in): R 50–100 Ω, phase ≈ 0, pA gate currents, T at base.
- **Row ≈ 50** (B ≈ 1.6 T, ~1 h 20 m in): per-column FFT on the landed rows for the light tone vs n.
- **Row ≈ 80** (B ≈ 3.3 T, ~2 h 15 m in): δF ≈ 1.4 T; heavy tone vs F_L in the high-n columns. Continue / abandon at this point. Abandon if no oscillation content appears or sr1 rails.
EOF
echo ok

I designed the electron-side Landau fan and appended it to the measure notebook with `--execute`, but I couldn't confirm it is actually running. A tool hook ended the session before I could check the cell's output. The background execute call returned exit 0 much sooner than a 3h40m fan should take, so it may have errored or never started. Please look at the notebook's last cell and whether `data/8/` exists before assuming anything is running.

Several things were left undone:
- I didn't send the "long auto-run started" Slack notification.
- `session_notes.md` has no entries from me.
- A `hera-watch data --next --follow` monitor is still running in the background, waiting for run 8.

**Why the fan is needed:** I analyzed spot-check runs 6 and 7 and put the read in ana (cells 14–16). Neither run can make the stacking call on its own.
- **Electron side, n = +3.2×10¹² (run 6):** oscillations start at 0.91 T. There are tones at 7.1 T (matches the ABAB light pocket), 22.3 T and 29.5 T, and nothing at F_L = 33.1 T, where an ABCA single pocket would sit. The 22.3/29.5 T tones could be harmonics of 7.1 T or an ABAB heavy pocket. Only how they move with density can tell those apart.
- **Hole side, n = −1.2×10¹² (run 7):** oscillations start at 0.71 T, but at D = 0 this side stops at −1.27×10¹² (top-gate limit). That is too close to the charge-neutrality point for the ABAB and ABCA patterns to separate.
- **Run 6 also has a step:** Rxx jumps from about 40 to 500 Ω between 7.4 and 8.2 T. Fitting the background across it gave a false onset of 0.30 T, so I analyzed only up to 7.4 T.

**The fan (measure notebook, last cell):**

| Setting | Value | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Density | n = 3.25 → 2.0×10¹², 30 points, D = 0 | 3.25 is where D = 0 hits the top-gate limit (V_tg = 0.998 V against 1.0). Below 2.0 the tones can't be resolved. |
| Field | 0.9 → 10 T, 103 rows spaced evenly in 1/B | 0.9 T is the computed run-6 onset. The spacing samples fast enough (up to 50 T) to cover the lever-arm uncertainty and keep folded harmonics out of the 0–40 T band being read. |
| Dwell | 2.1 s per point (7× the 0.3 s lock-in time constant) | Lets the lock-in settle; shorter dwell would weaken the heavy tone. |
| Sensitivity | sr1 fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ full scale) | Spot checks peaked at 12 % of that. |
| Auto-guards | Interrupt if either gate current exceeds 1 nA or T_sample exceeds 2 K; sr1 clipping is logged, not aborted | Nobody is watching the live plot in E1. |
| End state | Field left at 10 T, gates to 0 V | The next step (LK mass split or a ride-down) starts from 10 T without a re-traverse. |

The price is 200 min computed from runs 5 and 6, with the ETA set at 3h40m. Checkpoints are the first rows (about 10 min in), then around row 50 (~1.6 T) and row 80 (~3.3 T). The row-80 checkpoint is the continue/abandon call.

The fan cell checks its preconditions first: base temperature, field near 0 T, Si at 0 V, heaters off, lock-in time constant and drive unchanged. Because the notebook was reset to its bring-up state at handoff, the cell also sets sr1's sensitivity itself.

When the session resumes, the first job is to read the cell's output and `data/8/` if it exists. Then I'll re-arm or take over the monitoring, send the notification, and write the session notes.
